title: Remove the legacy governance copy from workflow-event
context: `.github/governance` is now the canonical home for inventory, policy, bundle order, orgs, backup policy, rulesets, App manifest, and archive history. workflow-event still carries duplicate copies under infra/config.

spec.summary: Point workflow-event scripts at a pinned .github governance checkout and remove the duplicate config tree.
spec.expected_outcome: workflow-event has one governance source: .github/governance at a pinned tag.
acceptance_criteria: Scripts read GOVERNANCE_DIR or a pinned .github checkout
Duplicate repos.json, policy.json, bundle-order.json, orgs.json, backup-policy.json, and archive-migration.json are removed
CI checks out .github at the pinned governance tag
Archive verification and inventory checks still pass
